name: tech-debt
description: Technical debt requiring refactoring or cleanup

name: epic
description: Epic - tracks a group of related sub-issues

name: blocked
description: Cannot proceed; the blocker is named in the issue

name: ready-to-build
description: Issue is fully specified and ready for development

name: human-setup

name: from-audit
